# Open Interpreter 0.0.65

## Models

- Add MiniMax M3.1 Flash to the provider catalogs.
- Keep model aliases from overriding canonical model IDs, and honor configured provider API URL overrides when generating catalogs.

## Goal notifications

- Include the immutable Goal ID in thread Goal update notifications so clients can distinguish a replaced Goal from an earlier Goal on the same thread. The field remains optional for older clients.

## Agent policy

- Carry caller policy information through agent execution and report its attestation to the caller.
